import serial
import sys
import time
port = sys.argv[1]
ser = serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=0.25)
end = time.monotonic() + 45.0
chunks = []
while time.monotonic() < end:
    data = ser.read(4096)
    if data:
        chunks.append(data)
ser.close()
sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(chunks))
PY
